question: What tap density did the NFA powders have?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%tap%' OR text ILIKE '%density%' OR text ILIKE '%g cm%' OR text ILIKE '%g cm−3%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%tap%' OR text ILIKE '%packing%' OR text ILIKE '%tapped%' OR text ILIKE '%bulk density%'

SELECT 'fact' src, id, statement FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%tap%' OR statement ILIKE '%density%' UNION ALL SELECT 'ocr', id, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%tap%' OR text ILIKE '%density%' UNION ALL SELECT 'cell', id, text FROM cells WHERE text ILIKE '%tap%' OR text ILIKE '%density%' UNION ALL SELECT 'line', id, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%powder%' AND (text ILIKE '%g%cm%' OR text ILIKE '%mass%' OR text ILIKE '%volume%')
